## Ctx.handleFreeText() method

Route handler for free-form text input.

**Signature:**

```typescript
/** @virtual */
handleFreeText?(): Promise<any>;
```
**Returns:**

Promise&lt;any&gt;

## Remarks

Triggered by any text not matching other routes, typically used with sessions.

## Example

this.msgText = "hello gramstax, random: 12848s8283n183m"

```typescript
async handleFreeText() {
   this.msgText // "hello gramstax, random: 12848s8283n183m"
}
```
